objectives: Explain the introduction of eating meat and the dietary law that stood with it.
Show that the laws of blood, sacrifice and life for life stood long before Moses.
Explain the token of the covenant and what happened between Noah and his sons.
takeaways: Man began to eat meat after the flood, but not everything: the creature is sanctified by the word of God, the dietary law (1 Timothy 4:1-5).
The law of the blood, animal sacrifice and life for life were in place long before Moses; the laws were never done away with (Matthew 5:17-18).
The rainbow is the token of the covenant with all flesh; the world has turned it into a symbol of sodomy.
A just man falleth seven times and riseth up again: Noah remained righteous (Proverbs 24:16).
Canaan was cursed as a servant of servants; the righteous seed and the Messiah would come through Shem.
